Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document 
 describes the regular maintenance that has to be done for HRSG F.T.(flow 
 transmitter) and the interval of each item of maintenance
The first draft is initiated by eng. Hany elokda, tested by eng. Bahaa abd 
 elwahab, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by 
 eng. Mohamed el sherif, general manager & eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPCo. 
 quality control general director, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of 
 Nubaria PS and certified by eng. Mohammed Nageb inspection and quality head 
 sector
Quantity | 64
Manufacture | Rosemount
TAG numbers | FIT(001A,001B,300,340A,340B..,etc)
Model | 3051
Electrical range | 4-20 m AMP
Supply Voltage | 24 v dc
Instrument Type | Flow transmitter
Service Description | Steam and Water
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Personal protective equipment 
 must be used (safety shoes, Helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses)
Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be hanged 
 on the work place, safety rope around the work place.
Tools 
and Equipment
Hart device
AVO meter
Blower & brushes
Cleaning fluids such as Freon - TF 
 chlorothene
Work to be 
carried out
Inspection and 
maintenance of F.T.
Make calibration procedures to the flow transmitters.
Check The Supply Voltage(24vdc)
Check The Output (4-20 m amp)
Transmitter Cleaning
Close the work permit.
